archetype_clustering.note: Silhouette ~0.04-0.05 is a cluster-separation metric, never accuracy. Clusters rest on manual coherence, not this number.

completion_risk.model: Cox proportional hazards (lifelines), right-censored at snapshot
completion_risk.note: C-index ~0.7 means the model ranks which works finish sooner better than chance. It is a completion-time model, never a probability of wrongdoing.

anomaly_detection.note: A multivariate outlier flag, corroborating other signals — never a verdict.

embedding.role: feature extractor, reused as a cache; not trained by us
